newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn ends higher, nearbys up daily limit.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn ends higher, nearbys up daily limit.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended sharply higher on Wednesday, with the three nearby months and the benchmark January contract up the daily limit of 400 yen per tonne at the close. January settled at 14,260 yen per tonne.
Prices extended early gains on active short covering, as bullish sentiment spilled over from the soybean futures, traders said.
"The nearby months, particularly, gained today ahead of the spot expiry next week," a brokerage house trader added.

On CBOT's Project A overnight electronic trading system, the CBOT spot December corn contract was traded at $2.67-1/2 per bushel at 0855 GMT, up from $2.65-1/2 at Tuesday's close, while spot January soybeans were at $7.06-1/2 per bushel, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
